title: CQL Quantity assigned to doseQuantity through a dynamicValue
description: Reproduction of the cqf-fhir 8.4.0 coercion bug: a test sig returns 625 'mg' from CQL and assigns it to dosageInstruction[0].doseAndRate[0].doseQuantity as a whole. Passes with the HAPI image pinned in phase0/docker-compose.yml, so the dose expressions can move back from FHIRPath sub-fields into the Library (oncology-regimens-m75).
subject: Patient/demo-cp-1
